# proxmox_storage_download_url (Resource)

Downloads a URL directly into storage through `POST /nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/download-url`. Destroy deletes the downloaded volume.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_storage_download_url" "debian" {
  node     = "pve"
  storage  = "local"
  url      = "https://cloud.debian.org/images/cloud/bookworm/latest/debian-12-genericcloud-amd64.qcow2"
  filename = "debian-12-genericcloud-amd64.qcow2"
  content  = "import"
  triggers = { revision = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Required

- `content` (String)
- `filename` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `storage` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)
- `url` (String)

### Optional

- `compression` (String)
- `verify_certificates` (Boolean)
